proves.claim: board_meta prefix reads and deletes prepare no statement whose query plan scans board_meta; the meta_key index serves them as a key range.

store.io-board-meta.prefix-read-uses-key.why: Without this case a prefix read would again scan every board_meta row, so the verify writer and other callers would slow as board history grows.

proves.claim: a board_meta prefix read stays under 20 ms and within 2x of an empty board on a board with 81,559 history rows, 1:10 of the live board.

store.io-board-meta.prefix-read-flat-wit.why: Without this case a prefix read whose cost grows with board_meta history would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: prefix reads return, in key order, and prefix deletes remove exactly the rows whose keys start with the prefix, including wildcard-looking and top-code-point prefixes.

store.io-board-meta.prefix-rows-unchange.why: Without this case a key-range bound that misses or adds rows at its edges would change what callers read or delete.
